name: sunny-pastures
description: Cosy farm and bakery idle game with a deterministic simulation shared by client and server.

scripts.supabase:check: v=$(supabase --version 2>/dev/null); [ "$v" = 2.122.0 ] || { echo "Supabase CLI 2.122.0 required, found: ${v:-none}" >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.check:task: pnpm check:fast && pnpm test:related && pnpm coverage:gate
scripts.check:full: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && SIM_PROPERTY_RUNS=1000 pnpm test && pnpm coverage:gate
